narr: A monsoonal push of moisture led to wet thunderstorms will slow storm tracks that created flash flooding, severe wind gusts, and debris flows.
ev: Law enforcement reported 6 to 12 inches of water flowing across lower South Fork Road. A vehicle driving along the road was washed off the road and pushed into the ditch, no one was injured.
